description: Roadworks, Incidents, Road Closures and Detours Real-time Information is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. This web service provides information about road works and incidents that are currently active in the metropolitan Adelaide area. It describes the location and type of the incident, the maximum delay caused and start and end dates. Coverage: metropolitan Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are closure, delays, detours, incidents, real-time. It offers 3 resource(s) in JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
